title: Props redrawn in depth
changes: Armour stands, racks, bounty boards, lanterns, pennants, training dummies, net racks, skull pikes, spear racks and the Redfang watchtowers are now drawn in true isometric depth.
Morwen's alchemy rig and Brann's weapon rack got the same treatment.
Well roofs are now pixel shingles, nomad tents are whole tents with an open front, and desert palms have new feathered fronds.
